title: EcoLife: Carbon-Aware Serverless Function Scheduling for Sustainable Computing
problem: Serverless computing platforms schedule functions across heterogeneous hardware without considering carbon emissions. Existing schedulers optimize for performance and cost but ignore environmental impact from different hardware generations.
motivation: Reducing data center carbon emissions is essential for environmental sustainability while maintaining application performance and quality of service.
method: ECOLIFE leverages novel extensions to Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) tailored for serverless environments to make scheduling decisions. The scheduler exploits heterogeneous multi-generation hardware diversity to intelligently place functions, jointly optimizing both carbon footprint and execution performance.
key_novelty: First carbon-aware serverless function scheduler that co-optimizes carbon emissions and performance through PSO-based scheduling.
contributions: Carbon-aware scheduler architecture for serverless platforms
PSO algorithm extensions designed for serverless execution contexts
Multi-generation hardware exploitation strategy to reduce carbon footprint
